source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Basic Business Planning Concepts (PDF 133, printed 129).

blocks.text: Bunyadi business planning mein yeh wazeh goals tay karna shamil hai ke business kya hasil karna chahta hai. Is mein product ya service pehchanna, target market samajhna aur customers tak value (faida) pohanchane ka tareeqa tay karna shamil hai. Entrepreneurs business chalane ke liye darkar wasail, jaise waqt, paisa aur skills, ki bhi planning karte hain. Ek saada business plan khayalat munazzam karta hai aur kamyab digital business shuru karne aur barhane ki simt deta hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Zyada tar nakam startups ke paas wazeh plan nahi hota.

blocks.prompt: Basic business plan mein kaun si cheezein shamil hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Wazeh goals, product ya service, target market, gahak ko value dene ka tareeqa, aur zaroori resources (waqt, paisa, skills) ki planning.

items: Business plan: goals, product, market, value aur resources; shuruaat aur tarakki ki simt.
